conviction_note: Read-throughs since AZZ last spoke on 2026-07-09 point both ways. Positive: zinc at a four-year high feeding surcharges into sales while the kettles burn zinc bought 6-8 months earlier, Valmont's utility and coatings strength, Nucor's higher Q3 steel-products volumes. Negative: Lennox residential HVAC units -12% (a Precoat end market), a single-source consensus that needs YoY growth to accelerate from 6.3% to ~10.8%, and both segment presidents selling in August. They net to about +0.4 on the findings. On the scaled measure I set p_up at 51, because the July beat-and-raise closed -1.88%, the bar has one source and the 25-delta skew is +10 toward puts. abs_move_pct is 6.0 off the 6.29% implied move. That gives +0.12. The two measurements agree in sign and are both near zero, which is the honest read.
bar: Q2 FY27 (quarter ended 2026-08-31) consensus adj EPS $1.83 on revenue $462.4M, Benzinga https://www.benzinga.com/quote/AZZ/earnings-forecasts (undated pull, single source; a TickFlow page showing $1.85/$446M looks like stale Q1 actuals and was not used). Company FY27 guide (2026-07-08): sales $1.80-1.85B, adj EBITDA $375-415M, adj EPS $6.75-7.15, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000008947/000000894726000163/exhibit991q1fy27earningsre.htm. Prior year Q2 FY26: sales $417.3M, adj EPS $1.55. Because the quarterly bar has one source, every finding that depends on it is capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest ~1.0M shares, 2.6 days to cover at the 2026-07-15 settlement (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/azz/short-interest/); 3.22% of float, 2.15 DTC at 2026-06-30 (https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/AZZ/short-interest). I found no September settlement. Not a crowded short. Baseline: 25d skew +10 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.42, total OI only 1,092, ATM spread 37% of mid, so the implied move of 6.29% is indicative only. Tape: 5d -2.47%, 20d +3.76%, 13.8% below the 52-week high (around $160). The stock traded $150-154 in mid-August and is $138 now.

findings.finding: LME zinc ran to a roughly four-year high during AZZ's fiscal Q2 (Jun-Aug 2026): $3,634/t on 2026-08-04, about $3,746 on 08-06, about $3,900 cash by 2026-09-01, up more than 25% YTD on low LME stocks. On the 2026-07-09 call management said Metal Coatings surcharges are in place because zinc is high and that 'you're going to see the surcharge impact flowing through in sales'. Zinc bought today reaches the kettles 6-8 months later (FIFO, per the 10-Q). Q2 sales therefore carry surcharges priced off current zinc while cost of sales carries zinc bought around Dec 2025 to Feb 2026 at lower prices. That is a tailwind to Metal Coatings revenue and margin against a Q1 segment EBITDA margin of 30.3% and 30.8% in Q2 FY26.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Metal Coatings margin fell 260bp in Q1 FY27 (land-sale comparison, project mix), and the July beat-and-raise still closed -1.88%. In Q2 FY26 the segment margin was down 90bp and the stock fell -4.9% on a revenue miss. This name has not reliably paid for beats.
findings.why_not_priced: The zinc price is public, but the sell-side has to model both the surcharge timing and the 6-8 month kettle lag. If the market had fully priced a margin tailwind, the stock would not sit 13.8% below its high with puts bid +10 vol points into the print. Part of the surcharge revenue is probably already in the $462M consensus, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: Management mechanism: https://earningswhispers.com/transcript/AZZ/Q12027 (2026-07-09 call). Zinc level: https://cbonds.fr/indexes/79107/ ($3,907.8/t on 2026-09-01) and https://www.reporteminero.cl/noticia/noticias/2026/08/zinc-maximo-4-anos-stocks-lme-desploman-64-por-ciento. FIFO and forward zinc purchases: 10-Q https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000008947/000000894726000162/azz-20260531.htm. The macro-to-company step is the company's own description, but the quarter's size is an inference.

findings.finding: Valmont (2026-07-21, after AZZ last spoke on 07-08/09) reported a strong quarter in North America Utility and Coatings and raised its full-year 2026 guidance. Its CEO said transmission, distribution and substation demand is strong and that capacity, not demand, limits growth. Utility T&D steel is a core hot-dip galvanizing end market for AZZ's Metal Coatings, which was +12.3% in Q1 and the subject of AZZ's 765 kV remarks.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Metal Coatings volume growth was the driver of the April +8.66% and January +6.56% prints by the release narrative. In July, +12.3% Metal Coatings growth still closed -1.88%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a peer's public print, so it is partly priced. AZZ's own Q2 Metal Coatings growth has not been seen since the guide raise. If the read-through were priced, the skew would not lean to puts.
findings.independence: Peer document, independent of the zinc finding. Valmont call highlights: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/valmont-industries-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-07-21/. Proxy, not AZZ's own number.

findings.finding: Nucor's Q3 2026 guidance (2026-09-17, covering Jul-Sep, which overlaps two months of AZZ's Jun-Aug quarter) expects higher steel-products earnings on higher volumes and higher realised prices. Steel products include joists, deck, rebar fabrication and building systems, the fabricated construction steel that feeds galvanizers and metal-building coil coaters. Nucor's total EPS guide of $5.55-5.65 was below the $6.17 consensus, on steel mills and raw materials, not on products.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No direct history linking Nucor read-throughs to AZZ reactions.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a broad-industry proxy, published after AZZ last spoke. Coverage of Nucor focused on the headline miss against consensus, not on product volumes, so its read-through to galvanizing volume is not a story anyone carried.
findings.independence: Nucor primary release: https://finviz.com/news/393374/nucor-announces-guidance-for-the-third-quarter-of-2026-earnings. Independent of the Valmont finding (different company and end markets). Proxy only.

findings.finding: Precoat Metals (53% of Q1 sales, $238.2M, +1.5%) had softer volume in construction, HVAC and appliance. On 2026-07-29, after AZZ spoke, Lennox reported residential HVAC unit volume -12% and revenue -7%, cut guidance on 'lower net volume expectations' and pushed the residential recovery into 2027. That points to continued weak HVAC coil-coating volume through AZZ's Jun-Aug quarter. What would have to go right in the rest: Precoat price increases and pass-through of input costs (the 10-Q guides Precoat ASP up), container sales ($20.8M vs $7.0M in Q1), the Washington, Missouri ramp running ahead of plan, and Metal Coatings, which is about 47% of sales and growing double digits. Net of that, a small negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2 FY26 (2025-10-08) Precoat sales -4.3% on weak building construction, HVAC and appliance demand drove a revenue miss ($417.3M vs ~$426M expected), and the stock fell -4.9%. That is the one recent print where this line decided the reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a customer-industry print after AZZ's last update, so analysts may still carry Precoat growth implied by the July guide raise. If it were priced, consensus would not require ~10.8% YoY total revenue growth.
findings.independence: Lennox call: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/lennox-international-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-07-30/. AZZ's own Q1 segment commentary: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000008947/000000894726000163/exhibit991q1fy27earningsre.htm. Proxy for one end market of one segment.

findings.finding: The quarterly bar steps up sharply. The Benzinga consensus of $462.4M revenue and $1.83 adj EPS implies +10.8% YoY revenue (vs $417.3M) and +18% YoY adj EPS (vs $1.55), against Q1 FY27 growth of +6.3% revenue and +3.9% adj EPS. Q1 beat a consensus of $434.7M that implied only +3%, so analysts moved from conservative to demanding after the July guide raise. Seasonal arithmetic from FY26 (Precoat Q2 below Q1 by ~3%, Metal Coatings Q2 ~1.5% above Q1) puts a Q1-like trajectory at about $450-460M before any surcharge uplift, so the revenue bar sits at the top of that range.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last revenue miss (2025-10-08, $417.3M vs ~$426M) traded -4.9%. The April and January revenue beats traded +8.66% and +6.56%. The July revenue beat (+3.2% vs consensus) with a raise traded -1.88%.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-13 (page accessed; consensus pull date not shown)
findings.why_not_priced: Previews quote the consensus but not the acceleration it requires. The stock is 13.8% off its high and puts carry a +10 vol premium, which is consistent with partial recognition.
findings.independence: Prior-year base: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/8947/000000894725000194/exhibit991q2fy26earningsre.htm. This finding shares the bar with every other reported-quarter finding and is capped because the bar has one source. It is in tension with the zinc-surcharge finding (surcharges lift revenue), and both are kept small for that reason.

findings.finding: Both segment heads sold stock in the middle of the reported quarter, in open-market sales with the Rule 10b5-1 box unchecked. Precoat President & COO Jeffrey Vellines sold 4,220 shares at $153.55 on 2026-08-11, leaving 1,834 directly held, about 70% of his direct position. Metal Coatings COO Bryan Stovall sold 2,677 shares at $150.07 on 2026-08-14, leaving 35,000, and that Form 4 is flagged 'not subject to Section 16'. The stock is now $138.09.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history of insider-sale signals on AZZ prints. Earlier 2026 sales by the CEO and CLO (Jan-Feb) preceded a +8.66% April print.
findings.why_not_priced: These are small Form 4s on a small-cap with thin coverage and no wire pickup. Selling by the person running the weaker segment (Precoat), mid-quarter, is the unusual part. The dollar amounts are small ($0.65M and $0.40M), so the signal is weak.
findings.independence: Stovall Form 4: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000008947/000000894726000178/wk-form4_1786740860.xml. Same type of document from a different person. No fundamental confirmation.

findings.finding: On the 2026-07-09 call, with about half of Q2 gone, the CEO said Q2 'got off to a really good start', that there was 'nothing on the horizon that gives us any concern' for summer and early fall, and that the Washington, Missouri plant was hitting run-rate targets sooner than budgeted. Data centers were the fastest-growing construction end market, at double digits.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The same call, with a guide raise, saw the stock close -1.88%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is the company's own public commentary, inside the guided range. It is filed because it shows management saw no Q2 problem at mid-quarter, which lowers the odds of a large miss.
findings.independence: Shares the transcript with the zinc finding (mechanism only). Raised guide in the release: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000008947/000000894726000163/exhibit991q1fy27earningsre.htm.

baseline_tension: The findings net slightly positive (+0.4) against a +10 put skew and a stock 13.8% off its high, so they cut mildly against the skew. The negatives (bar acceleration, Precoat HVAC, insider sales) agree with it. With a single-source bar and a name that sold its July beat-and-raise, I hold p_up at 51 rather than leaning long.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction; the July beat-and-raise closed -1.88%): zinc surcharge finding cut from +0.8 to +0.6.
Rule 6 (inside what the company guided; single-source bar): management 'good start' finding cut from +0.3 to +0.1; bar-acceleration finding capped at -0.4 from -0.6; p_up moved from 52 to 51.
Rule 5 (a proxy is filed small): insider-sale finding cut from -0.4 to -0.3. The Valmont, Nucor and Lennox proxies stand as filed small.
Rule 9 (segment net of the rest): the Precoat/HVAC finding was already sized net of Metal Coatings and Precoat pricing; left at -0.3.
Rule 7 (positioning): short interest checked (~2.6 DTC, not crowded); the negatives agree with the skew, so no change.
